description: Test suite for transcript-tools module, verifying functions to extract tool call names, check for tool calls, and count tool results within transcript content.

methods.name: extractToolCallNames
methods.description: Extracts normalized tool call names from given message object, handling various content types and keys.

methods.name: hasToolCall
methods.description: Determines if the given message object contains any tool call references.

methods.name: countToolResults
methods.description: Counts the number of tool result blocks and error blocks within message content, returning totals and error counts.
